_**Agent (gpt-5.4 2026-05-12 09:32:50Z)**_

The error is `non-fast-forward`: your local `main` is behind `origin/main`, so Git is refusing to overwrite remote commits.

Safest fix:
```bash
git fetch origin
git rebase origin/main
git push origin main
```

If rebase hits conflicts, resolve them, then run:
```bash
git rebase --continue
git push origin main
```

Only if you intentionally want to overwrite the remote branch history:
```bash
git push --force-with-lease origin main
```
